name: Rocket Stick - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Lemon Meringue Pie
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Rocket Stick Lemon Meringue Pie pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Lemon Meringue Pie serves up a bakery-fresh flavor: bright, zesty lemon up front layered over sweet whipped meringue and a buttery pie-crust finish. It's a tangy-meets-creamy dessert profile built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Signature Lemon Meringue Pie flavor — zesty lemon with sweet meringue and buttery crust
Smooth, even burn — flavorful from the first pull to the last
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Rocket Stick Lemon Meringue Pie is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
